method: Independently located each of the 340 exact old known text operators in both the prior raster-pinned PDF and current saved PDF. Text, font, size and every horizontal glyph origin are exact. Current baselines and Base14 glyph outline bounds are measured against the prior original PNG rule coordinates. Non-descender glyph body clearance must remain positive by more than one original pixel (0.3 pt); the minimum is 0.87 pt. This predicts source-rule clearance for semantic dispatch and does not substitute for fresh current-byte raster inspection. Ordinary underline/descender behavior remains distinguished from a line crossing letter bodies.
appearanceMethod: For all 92 old/current page pairs, every drawing geometry and every non-known text operator is equal after removing only the 340 matched known operators. All 1536 page XObject appearance decoded streams and bounds are equal. Source rules, choices, protected fields, known facts and page composition were not erased or redrawn.
